name: Facebook Pages
description: Facebook Pages gives businesses, organizations, creators, and public figures a public presence on Facebook. Relay connects one user-selected Page through Relay-owned Meta OAuth, lists at most ten recent Page-authored posts, drafts locally, and publishes one approved plain-text Page post.
agentUseSummary: Connect one user-selected Facebook Page with exact pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, and pages_manage_posts permissions. Agents can read bounded Page identity, list one page of up to ten Page-authored posts, draft locally, and publish one approved plain-text post; visitor feeds, arbitrary Pages, engagement, messages, media, insights, ads, administration, destructive actions, pagination, retries, and raw Graph access are blocked.

credentialRequirements: Relay-owned Meta app ID configured only on Railway
Relay-owned Meta app secret retained only by Railway
Separate encrypted user-token and selected-Page-token references

capabilities.label: Read selected Page
capabilities.description: Read bounded metadata for the Page immutably selected during connection.

capabilities.label: Read Page-authored posts
capabilities.description: List one page of at most ten recent posts authored by the selected Page.

capabilities.label: Draft Page posts locally
capabilities.description: Prepare a bounded plain-text draft without calling Meta.

capabilities.label: Publish plain-text Page posts
capabilities.description: Publish one approved plain-text post to the selected Page.

allowed.label: Get selected Page
allowed.description: Read bounded metadata for the immutably selected Page.

allowed.label: List Page-authored posts
allowed.description: List at most ten recent posts authored by the selected Page through its /posts edge.

allowed.label: Draft Facebook Page post
allowed.description: Create one bounded local plain-text draft without calling Meta.

approvalRequired.label: Publish Facebook Page text post
approvalRequired.description: Publish one plain-text post to the selected Page through its /feed edge after approval.

blocked.label: Use comments or engagement
blocked.description: Visitor feeds, comments, replies, reactions, and other engagement are blocked.

blocked.label: Use Page messages
blocked.description: Page messaging and private communication are blocked.

blocked.label: Use media or broader Page products
blocked.description: Media, stories, reels, insights, ads, leads, events, and search are blocked.

blocked.label: Use admin, destructive, or broad actions
blocked.description: Roles, settings, webhooks, edit, delete, scheduling, bulk actions, pagination, automatic ambiguous-write retries, raw Graph access, and browser automation are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Approval Required
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded selected-Page reads and local drafting run automatically; every Page publish requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four actions run without per-action approval; exact permissions, selected-Page binding, plain-text body, audit, one-page reads, and one-request write controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Mounts exactly four bounded selected-Page, Page-authored-post, local-draft, and text-publish wrappers.
